reason: Audit decision: repair on V4-02 with a real delta kept as WIP baseline. The V4-02 candidate (warm V2 palette, 575-key FR/EN i18n catalog with correct French accents, safe-area handling, Tâche/Task vocabulary, General Options at the bottom of Groups, social auth without demo/email/premium) is coherent and all product-level checks are green: trusted `npm run typecheck` clean, jest 537 tests / 26 suites PASS, `privacy:check` PASS (static contract + 71 tests), `cost:check` PASS (10 cost gates incl. 50k bounded reads, 0-reload tab switch, delta sync and classification cache), and the new `i18n:check` PASS (9 tests). Acceptance is nevertheless forbidden because trusted verification still exits 1. The trusted log (reports/audits/TRUSTED_37840884459.md) pinpoints the concrete cause, and it is NOT an infrastructure bug and NOT the auditor-proposed 'fix the verification runner': the failure is the expo alignment step `npx --no-install expo install --check` reporting six packages behind their SDK-expected versions, immediately before 'Found outdated dependencies' and 'Trusted verification exit code: 1'. verify-v4.sh runs under `set -euo pipefail`, so that legitimate expo check is the exit-1 source. The builder-run audit's suggestion to modify the verification script is rejected: weakening, disabling or bypassing a release gate is forbidden. The candidate is retained (no reconstruction); the single mustFix is to align the six Expo packages to the expected versions, regenerate package-lock so `npm ci` installs them, re-run the full verification to exit 0, and re-audit V4-02. V4-02 also still owes genuine visual-evidence for the warm palette / safe areas / FR-EN main journey before it can be accepted.
